fichas.title: Concert Halls: Origins, Variants, and Functional Scheme
fichas.summary: Overview of concert-hall origins, functional relationships in a concert building, and four common hall forms: block, arena, horseshoe, and fan-shaped. Concert houses primarily serve musical performances but may also host congresses and lectures; supplementary spaces can include chamber-music and rehearsal halls, tuning and warm-up rooms, and stores. Hall selection depends on urban-planning conditions, intended use, and acoustic requirements. The text relates hall geometry and surface conditions to reverberation, speech intelligibility, sound transfer, and viewing.
